title: Implement authenticated project creation API
objective: Allow an authenticated organization member to create a project inside their own organization, with input validation and tenant isolation enforced in the service layer.
acceptanceCriteria: Only authenticated users can create projects
The caller must be a member of the target organization
Project name is validated (1..80 chars, trimmed)
Duplicate project names are rejected per organization
The organizationId from the request body is ignored; it is derived from the session
Tests cover success, unauthenticated, cross-tenant and duplicate-name cases
forbiddenActions: add a new dependency without stating the reason in the completion report
